description.value: Big Orange is a long-running bubble tea franchise whose first store opened at Burnaby's Metrotown Mall in 1996, now operating dozens of locations across Canada, the US, and Malaysia. The North Vancouver outlet serves fresh fruit bubble teas, ice cream bubble teas, waffles, and desserts, with takeout available. On a hot cycling day the fruit-based slushes and teas make it a plausible refreshment stop.
